explanation: They scrape the irritating hairs off their abdomen with their back legs. The barbs lodge in skin and eyes, which deters predators, and a bald patch shows where they came from.

claims.text: Many New World tarantulas flick barbed, irritating (urticating) hairs from the abdomen at attackers.
Tarantulas do not spray venom, sticky silk or acid at attackers.
Tarantulas kick the urticating hairs off the abdomen with their hind legs.
Urticating hairs irritate the skin and eyes of predators.
Tarantulas that have flicked hairs often show a bald patch on the abdomen.
